annotations.title: Map buyer prompts for AI search

description: Find which buyer prompts to track in AI search. Returns the data to write that list from (search demand, trends, AI answers, citations, Reddit and YouTube wording), not a finished list. Track the chosen prompts with cite42_tracker_create. Charged only for the steps that succeed, at per-surface rates. Billed in USD (result field cite42Billing) to the user's prepaid Cite42 balance, and failed calls are free; exact prices from cite42_pricing (free). For plans over 20 calls or $5, estimate the cost and confirm with the user first.

brand.description: Optional brand/domain to include in prompt tracking recommendations.

fullSweep.description: Query all five AI surfaces (adds claude and google_ai_overview) for full cross-surface coverage, at a higher cost. Ignored when models is given.

models.description: AI surfaces to query, each billed separately; pass a subset when the user names surfaces or wants a lower cost. Omit for the defaults (chatgpt = the OpenAI API, perplexity, gemini); fullSweep queries all five. google_ai_overview accepts queries up to 700 characters, the others 2000.

topic.description: Market, product category, buyer problem, or audience to map prompts for.

name: cite42_map_ai_prompts
